previous_action: Gaius Maximus Valerius formally incorporates the newly secured territories and captured winter-pass holding into his estate, establishing recognized boundaries, appointing local administration, regularizing obligations and connecting the new lands to the existing estate, road and lake-port system.

continuity.campaign_development: The winter-pass holding captured in January has been formally incorporated into Valerius's estate. Its boundaries, productive resources, households, roads, stores and defensive works are now recorded under estate administration, with the holding linked to the established road and lake-port network. Local administration has begun, while Valerius remains in the field. The estate now controls a larger and more interconnected territorial base.
